i.norm: When one input sequence is empty, the Levenshtein distance equals the length of the other sequence (every remaining character must be inserted). Here the first input is a 305-character buffer and the second input is an empty sub-buffer (wrapped over the same backing buffer with an empty range), so the expected distance is 305.
Wrap an empty range [305, 305) over the backing buffer to obtain a length-0 sequence.
